name: validate-harness-flow
description: Single-shot dogfood agent. Given a freshly-cloned public repo (targetRepo), it drives the FULL harness setup flow end-to-end by invoking the child setup skills directly (NOT the interactive eng-harness-flow router): install the harness core, run eng-harness-0-harnessability-assessment, gate on the grade (abandon D/E/F or lowest Operate-Today band), hand-write .harness/engineering-harness.md governance from the 8 BIO fields, author a `boot` extension via eng-harness-0-add-extension, prove it boots, then record a retro via eng-harness-4-retro. Emits a structured PASS|FAIL|ABANDONED report plus a dual-layer (project|minih) retrospective.
author: AI-Substrate

files.description: Mission: cd to project root, install the harness into targetRepo, then drive the ordered setup skills (assess -> hand-written governance -> add-extension boot -> boot --validate -> record retro) directly. Encodes the abandonment gate, the 8 BIO governance fields, and the assessment->report field mapping. Documents skill wiring (.minih.json / --skill-source+--skill).

Rules: drive the setup skills (don't bypass or reimplement them), independent verification is mandatory (re-check via harness doctor/boot, never trust skill self-reports), prefer --json, throwaway writes only (the clone), capture friction at the moment of friction tagged project|minih.
Params: targetRepo (required abs path to the clone), harnessSource (local|github, default local), keepTarget (leave the clone on disk).

Structured report: targetRepo, harnessabilityGrade + axisTuple, abandoned + abandonReason, governanceWritten, bootAuthored, bootRuns, retroRecorded + retroRecordPaths[], verdict (PASS|FAIL|ABANDONED), summary, and a dual-layer retrospective (workedWell/confusing/magicWand/magicWandTarget/difficulties). Consumed by the orchestrator's --collect rollup.
